<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="jvkszjUy6ykkl4Zpc8be"> <mxGraphModel dx="2035" dy="961" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml UC07_View_Manager_Dashboard
!pragma teoz true

' =========================================================
' Visual configuration
' =========================================================
skinparam backgroundColor #FFFFFF
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam roundcorner 10
skinparam dpi 160
skinparam maxMessageSize 90
skinparam ParticipantPadding 22
skinparam BoxPadding 12

skinparam sequence {
 ArrowColor #334155
 ArrowFontColor #0F172A
 ArrowFontSize 12

 ActorBorderColor #2563EB
 ActorBackgroundColor #EFF6FF
 ActorFontColor #0F172A

 ParticipantBorderColor #2563EB
 ParticipantBackgroundColor #EFF6FF
 ParticipantFontColor #0F172A

 LifeLineBorderColor #94A3B8
 LifeLineBackgroundColor #DBEAFE

 GroupBorderColor #64748B
 GroupBackgroundColor #F8FAFC
 GroupHeaderFontColor #0F172A

 DividerBackgroundColor #DBEAFE
 DividerBorderColor #2563EB
 DividerFontColor #1E3A8A

 NoteBorderColor #F59E0B
 NoteBackgroundColor #FFFBEB
 NoteFontColor #78350F

 ReferenceBorderColor #64748B
 ReferenceBackgroundColor #F8FAFC
}

hide footbox
autonumber 1 \"<b>[00]</b>\"

title <size:20><b>UC-07 View Manager Dashboard</b></size>\n<size:12>Music School Workload Management System</size>

' =========================================================
' Participants
' =========================================================
actor \"Manager\" as Manager

box \"Music School Workload Management System\" #F8FAFC
 boundary \"ManagerDashboardPage\n<<boundary>>\" as UI
 control \"WorkloadController\n<<control>>\" as WC
 entity \"StaffMember\n<<entity>>\" as Staff
 entity \"TeachingJob\n<<entity>>\" as Job
 entity \"AvailabilityRecord\n<<entity>>\" as Availability
 entity \"JobPreference\n<<entity>>\" as Preference
 entity \"LeaveRecord\n<<entity>>\" as Leave
 entity \"SupportingDocument\n<<entity>>\" as Document
end box

' =========================================================
' Open dashboard
' =========================================================
Manager -> UI : openManagerDashboard()
activate UI

UI -> WC : requestDefaultDashboard(managerId)
activate WC

WC -> WC : authoriseManagerAccess(managerId)

alt Access denied
 WC --> UI : accessDenied()
 UI --> Manager : displayAccessDenied()

else Authorised Manager
 WC -> WC : determineCurrentWeek(SingaporeTime)

 note over UI, WC #E0F2FE
 The dashboard initially loads the current week.
 Every later week selection repeats the same retrieval.
 end note

 ' =====================================================
 ' Current week and selected-week refreshes
 ' =====================================================
 loop Initial load and whenever the Manager selects another week

 alt Initial dashboard load
 WC -> WC : setSelectedWeek(currentWeek)

 else Manager selects another week
 Manager -> UI : selectWeek(selectedWeek)
 UI -> WC : requestDashboard(managerId, selectedWeek)
 WC -> WC : validateSelectedWeek(selectedWeek)
 end

 group Load latest dashboard information

 ' -------------------------------------------------
 ' Retrieve active Staff Members
 ' -------------------------------------------------
 WC -> Staff : findAllActiveStaff()
 activate Staff

 Staff --> WC : activeStaffMembers
 deactivate Staff

 ' -------------------------------------------------
 ' Build each Staff Member summary
 ' -------------------------------------------------
 loop For each active Staff Member
 WC -> Job : findHoursAndAssignedStudios(\nstaffId, selectedWeek)
 activate Job

 Job --> WC : assignedHoursAndStudios
 deactivate Job

 WC -> Availability : findForWeek(\nstaffId, selectedWeek)
 activate Availability

 Availability --> WC : availability or notSubmitted
 deactivate Availability

 WC -> Preference : findForWeek(\nstaffId, selectedWeek)
 activate Preference

 Preference --> WC : preferences or notSubmitted
 deactivate Preference

 WC -> WC : buildStaffSummaryRow(\nstaffMember,\nassignedHoursAndStudios,\navailability, preferences)
 end

 ' -------------------------------------------------
 ' Retrieve late availability submissions
 ' -------------------------------------------------
 WC -> Availability : findLateSubmissionsAffecting(\nselectedWeek)
 activate Availability

 Availability --> WC : lateSubmissions
 deactivate Availability

 ' -------------------------------------------------
 ' Retrieve unassigned jobs
 ' -------------------------------------------------
 WC -> Job : findUnassignedForWeek(selectedWeek)
 activate Job

 Job --> WC : unassignedJobs
 deactivate Job

 end

 ' =================================================
 ' Load failure
 ' =================================================
 alt Required dashboard data could not be loaded
 WC --> UI : dashboardLoadError(message)

 UI --> Manager : displayLoadErrorAndRetryOption(message)

 note over Manager, UI
 No data is changed.
 An unresolvable error directs the Manager
 to the IT Administrator.
 end note

 else Dashboard data loaded successfully

 ' -------------------------------------------------
 ' Calculate highlights
 ' -------------------------------------------------
 WC -> WC : rankByAssignedHours(\nstaffSummaryRows)

 WC -> WC : selectThreeLeastLoaded(\ntieBreaker = staffName)

 note over WC #E0F2FE
 Exactly three Staff Members are highlighted.
 If assigned hours are tied, alphabetical order
 provides a deterministic tie-breaker.
 end note

 WC -> WC : identifyOvertimeStaff(\nthresholdHours = 40)

 note over WC #FFFBEB
 More than 40 assigned hours produces
 an overtime warning only.
 The dashboard does not allocate or block jobs.
 end note

 WC -> WC : summariseUnassignedJobs(\nunassignedJobs)

 note over WC #E0F2FE
 Supported unassigned reasons include:
 - Rejected by Staff Member
 - Staff Member on leave or MC
 - No qualified and available Staff Member
 end note

 ' -------------------------------------------------
 ' Prepare empty states
 ' -------------------------------------------------
 WC -> WC : applyDashboardEmptyStates()

 note over WC
 Empty-state rules:
 - No assigned jobs: 0 assigned hours
 - No availability: Not submitted
 - No late submissions: None
 - No unassigned jobs: 0 unassigned jobs
 - No overtime: No warning displayed
 end note

 ' -------------------------------------------------
 ' Display dashboard
 ' -------------------------------------------------
 WC --> UI : dashboardViewModel(\nselectedWeek,\nstaffSummaryRows,\nthreeLeastLoaded,\novertimeStaff,\nlateSubmissions,\nunassignedJobSummary)

 UI --> Manager : displayDashboard()

 note over UI, WC #E0F2FE
 The latest saved availability, workload,
 preferences, studio assignments and job status
 are returned whenever the dashboard loads.
 Target load time: no more than 3 seconds.
 end note
 end
 end

 ' =====================================================
 ' Alternative 7a: View related leave or MC record
 ' =====================================================
 opt Manager opens a leave or MC record for an unassigned job

 Manager -> UI : openLeaveMCRecord(jobId)
 UI -> WC : requestRelatedLeaveMC(\nmanagerId, jobId)

 WC -> WC : authoriseManagerAccess(managerId)

 alt Manager is not authorised
 WC --> UI : accessDenied()
 UI --> Manager : displayAccessDenied()

 else Manager is authorised
 WC -> Job : findLeaveRecordReference(jobId)
 activate Job

 Job --> WC : leaveRecordId or noReference
 deactivate Job

 alt No related leave or MC record exists
 WC --> UI : recordNotAvailable()
 UI --> Manager : displayRecordNotAvailable()

 else Related record exists
 WC -> Leave : findById(leaveRecordId)
 activate Leave

 Leave --> WC : leaveMCDetails
 deactivate Leave

 alt Record type is Leave
 WC --> UI : leaveDetails(\nstaffName, startDate, endDate)

 UI --> Manager : displayLeaveDetails()

 else Record type is MC
 WC -> WC : authoriseDocumentAccess(managerId)

 alt Document access denied
 WC --> UI : documentAccessDenied()
 UI --> Manager : displayDocumentAccessDenied()

 else Document access authorised
 WC -> Document : retrieveEncryptedDocument(\ndocumentId)
 activate Document

 Document --> WC : encryptedDocument
 deactivate Document

 WC -> WC : decryptForAuthorisedDisplay(\nencryptedDocument)

 WC --> UI : mcDetailsAndDocument(\nstaffName, startDate,\nendDate, document)

 UI --> Manager : displayMCDetailsAndDocument()
 end
 end
 end
 end
 end
end

deactivate WC
deactivate UI

' =========================================================
' Postcondition
' =========================================================
note over Manager, Document #E0F2FE
 Read-only interaction.
 Viewing or refreshing the dashboard does not create,
 update, allocate, reassign or delete system data.
end note

' =========================================================
' Legend
' =========================================================
legend right
 |= Colour |= Meaning |
 |<#EFF6FF> Blue | System participants |
 |<#E0F2FE> Light blue | Display or business rule |
 |<#FFFBEB> Amber | Warning or access constraint |
endlegend
